classification.difficultyReason: Construct useful midpoint triangles in the cube, infer equal spatial distances and apply cosine rule to the target angle.

inlines.text: Calculate the size of the angle
, giving your answer to one decimal place.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 20, cube below the stem on the left
spec.description: Black perspective cube with front face ADHE and rear face BCGF displaced upwards and rightwards. BF, FG and EF are dashed; all other cube edges and triangle RST are solid. R, S and T are dark midpoint dots on AB, FG and EH. Preserve all eleven italic point labels, with S below-left and F above-right. No angle arc, auxiliary Q, midpoint ticks or solution labels.
spec.mathematics: Cube side length 10. R=(A+B)/2, S=(F+G)/2, T=(E+H)/2 in the affine projection. Numerical 10 labels occur above BC, left of AE and below-right of HG. Requested angle TRS has vertex R.

answer.worked:
Let $Q$ be the midpoint of $EF$. In right triangle $RQT$:
$$\color{#268cff}\begin{align*}ST&=10\\[8pt]RQ&=10,\qquad QE=ET=5\\[8pt]QT&=\sqrt{5^2+5^2}=\sqrt{50}\\[8pt]RT&=\sqrt{10^2+(\sqrt{50})^2}=\sqrt{150}\end{align*}$$
By symmetry, $RS=\sqrt{150}$.
Using the cosine rule in $\triangle RST$:
$$\color{#268cff}\begin{align*}\cos\angle TRS&=\frac{(\sqrt{150})^2+(\sqrt{150})^2-10^2}{2\times\sqrt{150}\times\sqrt{150}}\\[8pt]\cos\angle TRS&=\frac{2}{3}\\[8pt]\angle TRS&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)\\[8pt]\angle TRS&=48.189685\ldots^\circ\\[8pt]\angle TRS&\approx48.2^\circ\end{align*}$$
